name: SEO Audit by OpenKrill
tagline: Audit a site for SEO problems and for how likely AI search is to cite it
description: A hosted, keyless MCP server that audits a live website. It crawls the pages itself and reports technical and on-page SEO problems: titles, descriptions, headings, canonical tags, structured data and broken internal links. It also scores how likely ChatGPT, Perplexity or Google AI Overviews are to cite a page, checks llms.txt and AI instructions files, drafts an llms.txt from the site's own pages, and checks local-business readiness for AI answers. Handy right after you deploy a site or a docs page. Read-only.

install.notes: No API key and no sign-up. Try: "Audit example.com for SEO problems" or "Does example.com publish an llms.txt?"
